title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1997 From the above table, it is evident that except Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and Delhi, in most of the States/UTs, very large number of women undertrials were released before completion of 1 year of detention period during the year 1997. Such release was 100% in Himachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Tripura, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Pondicherry.
